field_principles.accuracy_claimed: False prevents exact label agreement from becoming a prediction claim.
field_principles.arm_manifest: Frozen arms support a later matched comparison without changing this stream.
field_principles.arm_materialization_rows: One row per event and arm proves matched stream materialization.
field_principles.availability_matrix_path: The matrix makes every chronological release decision replayable.
field_principles.availability_rows: Per-decision rows expose which released records were eligible for each use.
field_principles.byte_budgets: Equal declared charges prevent resource differences from explaining later results.
field_principles.corruption_witness_rows: Contradictory witnesses make every poisoned label independently auditable.
field_principles.decision_view_path: The controller can read only information available at decision time.
field_principles.duration_s: Measure elapsed work with a monotonic clock; never pad or invent runtime.
field_principles.evaluator_truth_path: A sealed truth sidecar preserves independent audit authority.
field_principles.event_rows: Complete event projections bind each separated view to one event identity.
field_principles.exact_agreement_rows: Two exact calculations must agree before truth can be sealed.
field_principles.execution_venue: Host or device identity limits where the evidence applies.
field_principles.experiment_id: A fixed experiment ID prevents another task from supplying this stream.
field_principles.family_manifest: The family split prevents transfer labels from becoming adaptation support.
field_principles.feedback_view_path: A separate path lets the scheduler release feedback after decisions.
field_principles.field_principles: Echo each field reason so the artifact explains its evidence contract.
field_principles.gate_check_summary: Every blocked verdict names the exact failed check, upstream, field, expected value, and observed value.
field_principles.honest_verdict: A terminal description distinguishes useful evidence, null findings, disqualification, and external blocks.
field_principles.inference_substrate: Describe the computation actually executed, not merely planned.
field_principles.inference_substrate_class: Use the closed CPU class only after the declared exact work runs.
field_principles.leakage_rows: Field-level checks prove hidden truth is absent from decision inputs.
field_principles.learning_executed: False prevents fixture construction from becoming a learning claim.
field_principles.manifest_hashes: Manifest hashes prevent outcome-driven contract changes.
field_principles.manifest_paths: Each frozen contract has a separately reviewable immutable path.
field_principles.milestone: The milestone binds the stream to the V633 frozen contract.
field_principles.preconditions_checked: Name each resource and record its actual availability before measurement.
field_principles.random_seed: Freeze randomness so another process can reconstruct the study.
field_principles.recurrence_rows: Frozen recurrence links preserve later forgetting measurements.
field_principles.regime_manifest: Fixed chronological regimes prevent outcome-driven reorderings.
field_principles.regime_rows: Shift and recurrence remain visible to the evaluator only.
field_principles.reproducibility_checksum: Hash input contracts, code, seeds, and raw rows to expose drift.
field_principles.revocation_rows: Signed receipts make source replacement explicit and chronological.
field_principles.rows: Emit one row per unit and arm or condition, including errors and abstentions.
field_principles.run_date: Use 20260910; never copy a historical run date.
field_principles.schema: A versioned schema makes incompatible readers fail closed.
field_principles.sealed_view_hashes: View hashes detect any post-construction change.
field_principles.sealed_view_paths: Named view paths keep decision, feedback, truth, and timing bytes separate.
field_principles.source_artifact_hashes: Hashes bind inputs, code, and frozen contracts to the result.
field_principles.status: Use a terminal state only after the task work is complete or externally blocked.
field_principles.stream_ready_score: One requires a complete, sealed, causally ordered stream.
field_principles.template_operation_contract: A fixed operation grammar bounds the learned structural changes.
field_principles.transfer_rows: All held-out family and regime cells remain visible to the evaluator.
field_principles.verdict_class: Use positive, circular_positive, null, blocked, disqualified, or partial.
field_principles.verifier_is_oracle: Declare whether the scored verifier uses the same authority that labels the outcome.

honest_verdict: complete: sealed supersession stream ready; no learning or accuracy claim
inference_substrate: deterministic CPU integer predicates with independent exact replay; no model or learner
